entities.summary: Albin Walter Norblad Jr., was an American attorney and Republican politician in Oregon. He represented the U.S. state of Oregon's first district from January 18, 1946, until his death from a heart attack in Bethesda, Maryland, on September 20, 1964, in the United States House of Representatives. He was the son of Edna Lyle and A. W. Norblad Sr., a one-time governor of Oregon.
